problems.title: A basis generates a topology
problems.statement: Let $\mathcal B$ be a basis on a set $X$. Prove that the collection of arbitrary unions of elements of $\mathcal B$ is a topology on $X$.

problems.title: Continuity of the identity map
problems.statement: Let $\mathcal T_1$ and $\mathcal T_2$ be topologies on the same set $X$. Prove that the identity map $\operatorname{id}:(X,\mathcal T_1)\to(X,\mathcal T_2)$ is continuous if and only if $\mathcal T_2\subseteq\mathcal T_1$.

problems.title: Checking continuity on a basis
problems.statement: Suppose $f:X\to Y$ and $\mathcal B$ is a basis for the topology on $Y$. Prove that $f$ is continuous if and only if $f^{-1}(B)$ is open in $X$ for every $B\in\mathcal B$.
